title: Barbers: Prosecution relying on evidence, not new voting threshold

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution is relying on its evidence to convict Vice President Sara Duterte in her impeachment trial — not a modified voting threshold, former Rep. Robert Ace Barbers, House prosecution adviser and spokesperson, said on Wednesday. Barbers stressed that point during a post-trial news briefing after being asked about Senator-Judge Imee Marcos’ argument during the proceedings that the “finish line” should not be moved simply because the race had become difficult to finish. “Right from the start of this trial, we have never relied on numbers,” Barbers said in Filipino.
